svg.title: ϕ-Balancing for Mixture-of-Experts training
svg.desc: A router sends tokens to six experts. Mini-batch expert loads jump around; an exponential moving average m tracks the population load. Each expert gets a price q = ∇ϕ(m), high for busy and low for idle experts, and the auxiliary loss Σ q·p shifts routing until every expert receives about 1/E of the tokens.

g.text: Router spreads tokens; mini-batch loads are noisy
Track the population load with an EMA m
Loss Σ q·p moves tokens to cheap experts
p̄ = E_x[ p(x) ] over all data
